## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what was difficult or incorrect and what this change does for the user.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Separate offline tests from live
acceptance, and state what remains unverified.

## AI assistance

If applicable, name the coding tools used and explain how you reviewed the patch.
Do not include private prompts or hidden reasoning transcripts.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and its documentation is current.
- [ ] Behavioral fixes have an appropriate regression test.
- [ ] No tokens, browser profiles, account URLs or private content are included.
- [ ] Submission, recovery and permission boundaries remain intact.
